blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Building a small language model requires choosing which published improvements to combine. We compare five changes in the same model, using the same data and training budget. We test selected combinations and repeat each one with a second random seed. Mixture-of-experts layers, Muon optimisation and a Gated DeltaNet hybrid give the largest gains. Extra normalisation also helps, while an attention gate with a matched parameter budget adds little on average. The gains mostly combine, but small interactions between changes appear again in the repeated runs. Repetition also reveals benefits that an initial statistical estimate treated as noise. These findings apply to our small-model training setting; the expert models also have greater total capacity. The practical lesson is to test promising components together and repeat the comparisons before deciding which ones to keep.
blocks.zh: 构建一个小语言模型需要选择哪些出版的改进来结合. 我们利用同样的数据和培训预算,比较了同一模式的五个变化。 我们测试所选的组合,然后用第二个随机种子重复每个组合. 专家的混合层、穆恩优化和Gated DeltaNet的混合型收益最大。 额外的正常化也有帮助,而配有参数预算的注意门平均增加不多。 收益大多是结合的,但变化之间的小互动在反复运行中再次出现. 重复还揭示了初步统计估计被视为噪音的好处。 这些结论适用于我们的小型模式培训;专家模式的总能力也更大。 实际的教训是,在决定保留哪些部分之前,一起测试有前途的部分,重复比较。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Published improvements to language models are usually measured against different baselines. A builder must decide whether they will still help when used together. Two changes may provide the same benefit, or one may change how well the other works. We call the latter an interaction .
blocks.zh: 对语言模型的已公布的改进通常以不同的基线来衡量. 建造者必须决定他们在一起使用时是否仍然会有所帮助. 两项修改可能提供同样的福利,或者一项修改可能改变其他修改的效用。 我们称后者为互动。

blocks.en: We compare five changes in one implementation. G adds a sigmoid attention-output gate ( Qiu et al. 2025 ) ; M uses Muon to update hidden weight matrices ( Jordan et al. 2024 ; Liu et al. 2025 ) ; S normalises both the input and output of each sub-layer ( Ding et al. 2021 ; Kim et al. 2025 ) ; E adds small routed experts ( Dai et al. 2024 ; Wang et al. 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI 2024 ) ; and H replaces six attention layers with Gated DeltaNet ( Yang et al. 2024 ; Yang et al. 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了一项执行工作的五项变化。 G增加了一个 sigmoid 注意-输出门(Qiu等人,2025年);M使用Muon来更新隐藏的重量矩阵(Jordan等人,1996年)。 2024; 刘等 2025; S常态化每个子层的输入和输出(丁等. 2021; Kim 等 2025; E增加小路由专家(Dai等. 2024; 王等编. 2024; DeepSeek-AI 2024);和H用Gated DeltaNet(杨等. 2024; 杨等. 2025).

blocks.en: Testing every combination requires 32 configurations before any repeats. We use a classical fractional factorial design: a balanced selection of 16 combinations that allows several comparisons to share the same runs ( Fisher 1935 ; Box and Hunter 1961 ) . We then repeat each configuration with a second seed. A contrast is a difference between two group averages; for a single switch, it compares average loss with the switch on and off.
blocks.zh: 测试每个组合需要32个配置才能重复. 我们使用古典分数因子设计:平衡选择16个组合,允许多个比较共享相同的跑道(Fisher 1935; Box and Hunter 1961.). 然后我们用第二个种子重复每个配置。 一个对比点是两个组平均值的相差;对于一个开关,它比较平均损失与开关和关口.

blocks.en: The largest gains mostly combine, while smaller interactions also repeat. The design has an important limit: some effects are indistinguishable in the selected comparisons. This is called aliasing . Repeating the runs measures variability but does not remove that ambiguity. We report these limits alongside the results so that the study can guide component selection at the tested scale.
blocks.zh: 最大的收益大多是结合的,而较小的相互作用也重复。 设计有一个重要的限度:一些效果在所选比较中是无法区分的. 这叫做别名。 重复运行量度可变性,但不能消除这种模糊性。 我们报告这些限制和结果,以便研究能够指导测试规模的组件选择。

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 相关工作

blocks.en: Geiping and Goldstein (2023) study how to train masked language models within a single-GPU-day budget. Dodge et al. (2019) show why comparisons should account for the compute spent developing a model. Wen et al. (2025) show how optimiser rankings depend on tuning and the final training budget. Our study compares several choices together and repeats every selected combination.
blocks.zh: Geiping and Goldstein (2023)研究如何在单个GPU日预算中训练蒙面语言模型. Dodge等人(2019年)说明了为什么比较应该计入开发模型花费的计算. Wen等人(2025年)展示了Opimiser排名如何依赖于调和和最终的培训预算. 我们的研究把几种选择一起比较,重复每一个选定的组合.

blocks.en: Factorial language-model studies also predate ours. ATMA selects a long-context recipe with a complete 120-cell sweep of attention, memory, and training choices ( Akbar 2026 ) . Our contribution is a repeated comparison of five different types of change in a small decoder. Both the components and the experimental-design method are established.
blocks.zh: 阶梯语言模型研究也早于我们。 ATMA选择了长文配方,其中包含完整的120个细胞扫射关注,记忆,和训练选择(Akbar 2026). 我们的贡献是对小解码器中五种不同变化的反复比较. 构件和实验设计方法均被确立.

blocks.en: Model, Switches, and Training
blocks.zh: 型号、开关和培训

blocks.en: Common protocol
blocks.zh: 共同协议

blocks.en: The baseline is an eight-layer decoder of width 512 with eight 64-dimensional heads, SwiGLU feed-forward width 1,408, pre-RMSNorm, query/key normalisation, rotary positions, and tied embeddings. Its vocabulary has 50,304 entries and it contains 51,455,488 parameters. These are standard Transformer choices ( Vaswani et al. 2017 ; Shazeer 2020 ; Zhang and Sennrich 2019 ; Henry et al. 2020 ; Su et al. 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 基线为宽度为512的八层解码器,有8个64维头,SwiGLU向前的宽度为1,408,前RMSNorm,查询/键正态,回转位置,并有捆绑嵌入. 其词汇有50,304个条目,包含51,455,488个参数. 这些是标准变形器选择(Vaswani等2017;Shazeer 2020;Zhang和Sennrich 2019;Henry等. 2020; Su等2024 (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: We train on FineWeb ( Penedo et al. 2024 ) , using GPT-2 byte-pair tokenisation and the NanoGPT-speedrun shard format ( Radford et al. 2019 ; Jordan and others 2024 ) . Sequences contain 1,024 tokens. Four micro-batches of 16 sequences give 65,536 tokens per step; 4,577 steps reach the nominal 300M-token budget. Final validation measures next-token cross-entropy over 10,485,760 held-out tokens. Seeds change initial weights and the contiguous range of training shards. Configurations with the same seed receive identical batches, checked by first-batch hashes. Loss is in nats per token; lower is better.
blocks.zh: FineWeb(Penedo等2024年)的训练,使用GPT-2字节-pair符号化和NanoGPT-speedrun shard格式(Radford等2019年;Jordan等2024年). 序列中包含有1,024个符. 由16个序列组成的4个微管每步给出了65,536个令牌;有4,577个步骤达到了名义上300M-token的预算. 最终验证措施 下一指针交叉 超过10,485,760个被扣留的标志。 种子会改变初始重量和相接的训练软体. 具有相同种子的配置得到相同的批次,由第一批散列检查. 损失额为每兆纳特;较低则更好。

blocks.en: The learning rate rises for 300 steps, remains constant, then falls linearly over the last 20% of training. AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter 2019 ) uses momentum coefficients ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) and gradient clipping at 1.0. Preliminary sweeps select one peak rate per optimiser family: 0.002 0.002 for AdamW and 0.016 0.016 for Muon. For the relevant matrix groups, decay preserves the baseline product η ​ λ = 2 × 10 − 4 \eta\lambda=2\times 10^{-4} of peak rate and weight decay. Muon updates hidden matrices with five Newton–Schulz iterations, momentum 0.95, and the Moonlight update scale. Embeddings, norms, routers, gates, and convolution kernels retain AdamW. Thus M compares complete optimiser recipes, including rates and parameter groups. We do not tune each architecture separately.
blocks.zh: 300个步骤的学习率上升,保持不变,然后在最后20%的培训中线性下降。 AdamW (Loshchilov和Hutter 2019)使用动力系数(0.9,0.95)和梯度剪接为1.0. 初步扫取每个选取者家族选择一个峰值率:亚当W为0.0020.002;穆恩为0.0160.016. 对于相关的矩阵组,衰变保留了峰值速率和重量衰减率的基线产物 QQ = 2× 10− 4\eta\lambda=2\times 10× 4}. Muon更新了隐藏的矩阵,有5个牛顿-舒尔茨迭代,动力0.95,以及月光更新尺度. 嵌入,规范,路由器,出道口,和演化内核保留了亚当W. 因此M比较了完整的选取器配方,包括率和参数组. 我们并不分别调整每个架构。

blocks.en: Table 1: The five switches, each of which can be on or off. They share one training implementation. Active parameter counts are approximately matched; total counts are not.
blocks.zh: 表1:五个开关,每个开关都可以打开或关闭. 他们共享一个培训执行方案。 活动参数计数大致匹配;总计数不匹配.

blocks.en: What each switch changes
blocks.zh: 每个开关都改变什么

blocks.en: Table 1 defines the switches. G adds a 512 × 512 512\times 512 projection to each attention layer. We pay for it by reducing feed-forward width from 1,408 to 1,240 and active expert width from 352 to 309. G therefore tests whether the gate is a useful way to spend the parameter budget.
blocks.zh: 表1界定了开关。 G在每个关注层上都增加了512×512 512\times 512投影. 我们为此付出了代价,将向前进的路由从1 408道减少到1 240道,将积极的专家路由352道减少到309道。 G因此检验闸门是否是花费参数预算的有用方式.

blocks.en: For E, a sigmoid score and a balancing bias select the top three routed experts. The bias receives no gradient. Output weights use the original scores, normalised over the selected experts and multiplied by 3 \sqrt{3} ; the shared expert is always active. A sign update increases the selection bias of underused experts. Its step size is 10 − 2 10^{-2} for 1,000 steps and 10 − 3 10^{-3} thereafter. A sequence-wise balance term has coefficient 10 − 4 10^{-4} . The model has about 161.3M total and 51.6M active parameters. Its gain can therefore reflect both routing and roughly three times the total capacity.

blocks.en: For H, unit-normalised keys drive the gated delta update, S t = α t ​ ( I − β t ​ k t ​ k t ⊤ ) ​ S t − 1 + β t ​ k t ​ v t ⊤ , S_{t}=\alpha_{t}(I-\beta_{t}k_{t}k_{t}^{\top})S_{t-1}+\beta_{t}k_{t}v_{t}^{\top}, (1) where α t , β t ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \alpha_{t},\beta_{t}\in(0,1) and each head stores a 64 × 64 64\times 64 state ( Yang et al. 2025 ) . Causal width-four convolutions filter the projected queries, keys and values before the memory update. The two remaining attention layers use no positional encoding (NoPE) ( Kazemnejad et al. 2023 ) . H tests this whole hybrid recipe.

blocks.en: This is a resolution-V design ( Box and Hunter 1961 ) : single-switch and pairwise effects can be separated from each other, but some higher-order effects remain mixed in. For example, G ≡ M ​ S ​ E ​ H G\equiv MSEH and G ​ M ≡ S ​ E ​ H GM\equiv SEH . The measured G contrast includes the four-switch effect MSEH; the measured GM contrast includes the three-switch effect SEH. Interpreting them as G or GM alone requires those higher-order effects to be small. Replication cannot separate them. A small measured contrast could also hide two large contributions with opposite signs.

This estimate comes from the effects themselves, rather than repeated runs.

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: The main gains repeat
blocks.zh: 主要收益重复

blocks.en: Experts, Muon, and the hybrid give the largest average reductions in loss (Table 2 , Figure 1 ). Extra normalisation also helps. Single-switch contrasts differ by at most 0.004 nats between seeds. The Pearson correlation is 0.996 across all 15 contrasts and 0.94 across interaction contrasts alone.
blocks.zh: 专家、Muon和混合体平均减少的损失最大(表2,图1)。 额外的正常化也有帮助。 单开关的对比值在种子间最多为0.004纳特时不同. 皮尔逊的关联性在所有15个对比中为0.996个,仅在相互作用中为0.94个.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Average loss differences for each switch at both seeds. Negative values favour the switch. Markers show estimates from different seeds, not uncertainty ranges. Each comparison can also include the corresponding four-switch effect because of the selected design.
blocks.zh: 图1:两个种子上每个开关的平均损失差额。 负值偏好开关 。 标记显示来自不同种子的估计,而不是不确定性范围. 每次比较还可以包括由于所选设计而相应的四开关效果.

blocks.en: Table 2: Loss contrasts in nats. A slash names effects that this design cannot separate. Single-switch rows also include four-switch effects. Means use unrounded losses, so they may differ from averages of the displayed values. The reference margin for a mean is ± 0.0043 \pm 0.0043 , under the noise assumptions in the text.
blocks.zh: 表2: Nats中的损失对比。 这种设计无法分开的斜线命名效果 。 单开关行也包含四开关效果. 表示使用未四舍五入的损失,因此可能与所显示数值的平均值不同. 根据正文中的噪声假设,一个平均值的参考比值为±0.0043\pm 0.0043.

blocks.en: The gate shows why the common comparison matters. Adding G alone to the all-off baseline reduces seed-0 loss by 0.019 nats. Across the selected combinations, its repeated mean is instead + 0.0018 +0.0018 , within the reference margin. Spending active parameters on this gate gives little average benefit here. This does not tell us whether an extra gate without a narrower feed-forward layer would help, or which other change reduces its benefit.
blocks.zh: 大门显示共同比较为何重要. 将G单加到全能基线中,种子-0损失减少0.019纳特. 在整个选定的组合中,其重复的平均值是+0.0018+0.0018,在参考差内。 将活性参数花在这个门上给这里带来的平均好处很少. 这并不能告诉我们,没有更窄的进取饲料层的额外闸门是否有帮助,或者哪些其他变化会减少其好处。

blocks.en: Gains mostly combine, with small interactions
blocks.zh: 收益主要结合,小互动

blocks.en: The largest mean pairwise contrast is MH/GSE at + 0.0122 +0.0122 nats. Adding the reference margin gives about 0.017 nats, below the experiment’s practical bound of 0.02 nats. Even so, six pairwise means and four single-switch means exceed the reference margin. The three largest seed-0 interaction contrasts—SE/GMH, GM/SEH, and MH/GSE—keep their signs and exceed the single-seed reference margin of ± 0.0060 \pm 0.0060 at seed 1.
blocks.zh: 在0.0122+0.0122纳特时,最大正对比为MH/GSE. 加入参考比值后,大约给出了0.017纳特,低于实验的实际约束值0.02纳特. 即便如此,有6个双向表示和4个单向开关表示都超过了参考比值. 三种最大的种子-0相互作用对比——SE/GMH,GM/SEH,和MH/GSE——保持其标志并超过种子1的单种子参考比值±0.0060\pm0.0060.

blocks.en: The large gains therefore mostly combine, but the smaller departures matter when comparing modest refinements. If higher-order effects are negligible, a pairwise contrast of 0.012 means that turning one switch on changes the other’s benefit by about 0.024 nats.
blocks.zh: 因此,大收益大多是结合在一起的,但小收益的去向在比较适度改进时很重要。 如果更高顺序的效果可以忽略不计,则0.012的对比意味着将一个开关对另一个开关的效益变化了约0.024纳特.

blocks.en: The all-five configuration has the lowest loss in the selected set at both seeds: 3.6792 and 3.6750 nats. The untested combinations or separately tuned recipes could do better. In particular, G’s near-zero average does not show that removing it from the all-five model would help: that four-switch configuration was not run.
blocks.zh: 全部5个配置在所选的组合中损失最低的有: 3.6792和 3.6750 nats. 未测试的组合或单独调制的配方可以做得更好。 特别是,G的近乎零平均值并不能显示将其从所有5个模型中移除会有所帮助:4个开关配置没有运行.

blocks.en: Repeats reveal smaller effects
blocks.zh: 重复显示较小的效果

blocks.en: Lenth’s PSE implies a run standard deviation near 0.020 nats, using the single-seed contrast standard error σ / 2 \sigma/2 . That is about six times the repeated-run estimate of 0.0036. The initial margin separates only E, M, and H from zero; the repeated-run reference also separates S and several interaction contrasts. Many effects in this experiment contain signal, so their spread overestimates noise. This explains the conservative initial result without implying that Lenth’s method generally fails.
blocks.zh: Lenth 的 PSE 意味着运行标准偏差接近0.020 nats, 使用单种子对比标准出错 / 2\ sigma/2 。 这大约是重复运行估计的0.0036的六倍. 初始比值仅将E,M,和H从0相分离;重复运行的参考也将S和多个交互对比相分离. 这个实验中的许多效果都包含信号,因此其扩散会高估噪音. 这解释了保守的初始结果,但不暗示伦斯的方法一般都失败了.

blocks.en: Checking the Implementation
blocks.zh: 检查执行情况

blocks.en: Two numerical failures were found during development, repaired, and excluded from the final results. First, an RMSNorm GPU kernel let a position use information from the next token at a particular row-byte width. The resulting very low loss was invalid. Tests at the actual model width, changing future tokens at both odd and even positions, exposed the leak and checked the replacement formula. Smaller-width tests had missed it.
blocks.zh: 在开发过程中发现了两个数字故障,进行了修复,并被排除在最后结果之外。 首先,一个RMSNorm GPU内核让一个位置在特定行字节宽度上使用从下个符的信息. 由此产生的非常低的损失无效。 实际模型宽度的测试,在奇点甚至位置上改变后期活符,曝光出漏出并检查了替换公式. 更小一点的测试都错过了

blocks.en: Second, the sigmoid router could produce finite outputs but non-finite gradients when selected scores were extremely small. Replaying a saved failing batch traced this to a squared denominator that underflowed during differentiation. We use the equivalent expression g i = ρ ​ softmax i ∈ 𝒦 ⁡ ( log ⁡ sigmoid ⁡ ( ℓ i ) ) , g_{i}=\rho\,\operatorname{softmax}_{i\in\mathcal{K}}\big(\log\operatorname{sigmoid}(\ell_{i})\big), (7) with a stable log-sigmoid implementation and ρ = 3 \rho=\sqrt{3} , instead of differentiating ρ ​ s i / ∑ j ∈ 𝒦 s j \rho s_{i}/\sum_{j\in\mathcal{K}}s_{j} directly. The final comparison uses runs after both fixes.
blocks.zh: 第二,Sigmoid路由器可以产生有限度的输出,但当选定的分数极小时,非无限梯度。 重放被保存的失败批次可追溯到一个平方分母,该分母在分化过程中会流出. 我们使用等同的表达式g i = ρ k (log ⁡ sigmoid ⁡ (l i )), g i rho\,\ operatorname{softmax }_{\\ in\ mathcal{ K}}\ big (\ log\ operatorname{ sigmoid} (\ ell\\ i )\ big)), (7) 具有稳定的日志- sigmoid 执行和 ρ → 3\rho\ sqrt{ 3} , 而不是直接区分 s i / j\rho s_{i}/\ sum\ j\\ mathcal{ K}}s_{j} 。 最后的比较使用在两个修正之后。

blocks.en: Limitations and Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 限制和可复制性

blocks.en: The study covers about 51.5M active parameters, one corpus, a 1,024-token context, and a nominal 300M-token budget. Training time, energy and inference speed are not matched. The results do not establish downstream or long-context gains, or behaviour at larger scales. Optimiser comparisons show why size, tuning and final budget can change rankings ( Wen et al. 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 该研究涵盖约51.5M活性参数、1个实体、1 024个上下文和300个上下文。 训练时间、能量和推断速度不相称。 结果不能确定下游或长期收益,也不能确定更大范围的行为。 优化比较显示规模、调整和最终预算为何可以改变排名(Wen等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: E adds total capacity, G spends some feed-forward capacity on a gate, H changes both recurrent mixing and nearby design choices, and M includes several optimiser settings. These are comparisons of complete recipes. Also, the selected combinations cannot separate all effects. A complementary selection or targeted extra configurations would be needed to resolve the remaining ambiguity.
blocks.zh: E增加了总容量,G将一些向导容量花在一个门上,H既改变经常性混合,也改变附近的设计选择,而M包括了几个opimiser设置. 这些是完整的食谱的比较. 另外,所选择的组合不能将所有效果分开. 需要补充选择或有针对性的额外配置,以解决剩余的模糊问题。

blocks.en: Two seeds give little information about each configuration’s full distribution. The noise pool assumes a common variance, and shared data streams may correlate errors. Both seeds are reported to make their agreement visible. The same validation corpus supports preliminary tuning and final comparisons, so these are development results rather than measurements on a fresh test set.
blocks.zh: 两个种子对每个配置的完整分布信息很少. 噪声池假设一个常见的差异,共享的数据流可能与出错相关. 据报道,这两种种子都使其协议明显可见. 同一鉴定机构支持初步调整和最后比较,因此,这些是发展成果,而不是对新成套测试的衡量。

blocks.en: An evidence ledger links definitions, settings, final losses and calculations to the source report and generated tables. It does not contain every raw log or checkpoint. The 32 core runs, learning-rate sweeps and extra H repeats must be counted separately. Reproduction should first check future-token causality at the model width, finite router gradients on extreme logits, and matching data streams. Equations 4 – 5 then give the calculations from completed valid runs.
blocks.zh: 证据分类账将定义、设置、最后损失和计算与源报告和生成的表格联系起来。 它不包含每个原始日志或检查站。 32个核心运行,学习率扫射和额外的H重播必须分别计算. 复制应首先检查模型宽度的后接因子,极端对数上的有限路由器梯度,并匹配数据流. 方程式4 – 5 然后给出已完成的有效运行的计算结果.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: In this training setting, experts, Muon, a Gated DeltaNet hybrid and extra normalisation reduce average loss. A gate with a matched parameter budget adds little on average. The main gains mostly combine, but small interactions repeat. Comparing components together and repeating the runs gives a clearer basis for deciding which changes to keep.
blocks.zh: 在这一培训环境中,专家Muon、Gated DeltaNet混合体和额外正常化减少了平均损失。 配有参数预算的闸门平均增加不多。 主要收益大多是结合的,但小互动重复. 将组件相比较并重复运行,为决定保留哪些变化提供了更明确的基础。
